newsitem.title: CHINA: TABLE-CHONGQING CHANG'AN H1 NET UP 41 PC.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-CHONGQING CHANG'AN H1 NET UP 41 PC.

text.p: Half year ended June 30, 1997 (in millions of yuan unless stated, against first-half 1996 figures):
Earnings per share 0.144 yuan vs 0.176 yuan
Net assets per share 2.68 yuan vs 1.72 yuan
Company name: Chongqing Chang'an Automobile Co Ltd.
Note: The results, calculated under Chinese accounting standards except for net profits, were published in the China Securities newspaper last Saturday.

The company had 876.19 million outstanding shares at the end of June, including 120 million domestic A shares offered to the public in May and 250 million B shares. The company is one of China's top mini-sedan car makers.
